senses.definition_en: pregnant

examples.english: The seahorse is the only male animal that gets pregnant.
examples.text: El caballito de mar macho es el único animal que queda embarazado.
examples.translation: The seahorse is the only male animal that gets pregnant.

examples.english: No member of the family is pregnant.
examples.text: Ningún miembro de la familia está embarazado.
examples.translation: No member of the family is pregnant.

examples.english: It seems that the unbelievable plot of the movie "Junior" (1994), in which Arnold Schwarzenegger stars, for the love of God, as a pregnant man, is actually a real thing that happened.
examples.ref: 2008 April 1, Ana Gómez, “Hombre embarazado”, in Tiempo Habitual Online, archived from the original on 10 Dec 2021:
examples.text: Parece ser que la increíble trama de la película “Junior” (1994), donde Arnold Schwarzenegger protagoniza, por amor, a un hombre embarazado, es también increíblemente, una realidad.
examples.translation: It seems that the unbelievable plot of the movie "Junior" (1994), in which Arnold Schwarzenegger stars, for the love of God, as a pregnant man, is actually a real thing that happened.

examples.english: In total there will be 37 completely new icons with a focus on diversity: they will include a pregnant man and a pregnant person, without revealing their [the person's] gender.
examples.ref: 2022 February 1, “Llegan los nuevos emojis inclusivos de Apple: hombre embarazado, saludos interraciales y más”, in Clarín, archived from the original on 08 Mar 2022:
examples.text: En total serán 37 iconos totalmente nuevos con el foco puesto en la diversidad: incluirán a un hombre embarazado y una persona embarazada, sin revelar su género.
examples.translation: In total there will be 37 completely new icons with a focus on diversity: they will include a pregnant man and a pregnant person, without revealing their [the person's] gender.

senses.definition_en: uncomfortable

examples.text: El pescador llevaba, en lugar de su camisa de bayeta colorada, una blanca muy almidonada, y una chaqueta nueva de paño azul basto, con cuyas galas estaba tan embarazado que apenas podía moverse.
examples.translation: The fisherman wore, instead of his red cloth shirt, a very starchy white one, and a new jacket of coarse blue cloth, with whose clothes he was so uncomfortable that he could hardly move.

examples.ref: 1844, Enrique Gil y Carrasco, chapter 26, in El Señor de Bembibre:
